test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Cat : Meow :: Birds : ?
solution:
**The logic followed here is: **Animal : Sound of the animal 

__
 
• Cat sound is called **m**eow.

Similarly,

 
• **Birds** sound is called **chirp**.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Chirp**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• Hiss - It is the sound of snakes.
 
• Chirp - It is the sound of birds
 
• Neigh - It is the sound of horse
 
• 
 
Growl - It is the sound of felines, bears, canines and crocodilians.
